explanation: The statement is about the library-local definitions `cylindricalPressure`, `nativePressure` and `PhysicalParticularWave.nativeMap`, which do not occur anywhere in Mathlib/Batteries/Lean core. Its mathematical content is essentially that a constant multiple of a composed real part of a function is C^∞ when the function is, proved from `contDiffAt_const.mul` and `ContDiffAt.comp`; Mathlib has no declaration stating this because the notions (`cylindricalPressure`, `nativePressure`) are defined in this library. Recovering the statement from `ContDiffAt.const_mul` would require unfolding the library definition and supplying the composition/ChainRule fact, which is more than routine glue.
